revision: 2026-10-16 image-generated painted status frame replaces rejected local border
authorization: Owner requested remaining artwork differences fixed against the exact approved reference. This supersedes the former reconstruction-only art workflow; values, paths, labels and input remain live.
method: Approved source pixels sampled at runtime for existing roles. Stats uses a complete built-in-image-generated painted frame; its original PNG is unchanged. Geometry only maps texture pixels into live controls; no dynamic values are baked into artwork.
card_sampling_exclusions: Upper-left corner mirrors the clean upper-right corner horizontally in UV space, excluding the original cost crystal and numeral while keeping the upper-rim orientation.
Upper horizontal rim starts 47px from card left, excluding cost badges.
Left center rim starts 53px below card top, excluding the overlapping badge.
Symbol/name/type/description are excluded from all interior patches.
live_content: boss identity, role, intent and HP

fallbacks.card_mixed: Shares the reference violet frame; no distinct mixed card appears in the approved image.

limits: Obscured face pixels are not available in the flattened reference. Clean reference patches fill those areas, so their texture arrangement is reconstructed.
Mirrored upper-right card corners and clean strip sections replace portions hidden by live reference content.
Dynamic live labels and game-state values intentionally remain independent.

board_material_transform.purpose: Preserve stone brush scale in visible surround; most repeated boundaries are hidden under live sockets.

sampling_masks.purpose: Exclude neighboring backdrop and caption pixels from nonrectangular atlas samples; preserve the source artwork and map each point through the same nine-slice transform as its rim.

reference_piles.mapping: Each distinct approved stack uses one uniform scale centered in the art lane. Only the original numeral pixels are replaced with clean material; count and caption remain live. No mirroring, nine-slicing, or generated compass/skull overlays.
reference_piles.discard_caption_exclusion: The source DISCARD caption starts at y1554; the silhouette ends at that upper boundary, excluding the original caption while retaining the complete count plaque rim. Body dimensions and uniform scale are unchanged.

card_corner_repair.cause: The former upper-left substitution copied a lower-left corner without changing orientation, including below-frame background pixels. The smaller live cost glyph exposed the gap.

stats_composition.method: Render the generated slate, closed frame and two dividers as texture pixels. Source-grid sampling fits the 54px row and aligns the three live cells. No code-drawn border, source-art patches, locally painted bitmap or baked game values.
stats_composition.source_pixels: Generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; texture sampling only. Legacy stats atlas rectangles/caps are historical metadata and are bypassed for this role.

board_corner_cleanup.cause: The old lower cap included the adjacent toolbar corner below the board rim.

backdrop_sampling.cause: The old x818 source strip included original gold frame pixels near y1244-1252. Its 23*k destination width also left a subpixel seam beside the live board, exposing the underlying candle as a thin bright stroke. The clean x824 rock strip overlaps the live frame edge by one pixel to prevent that seam.

cast_composition.cause: Replacing only the rectangular nine-slice center retained the darker original face inside the right cap, creating a vertical turquoise seam at source x649.
cast_composition.destination_caps_formula: Vector4(57,12,57,12) * art_scale, fitted to the existing destination extent
cast_composition.contour_mapping: Map outer and inner source points through the existing nine-slice cap transform.
cast_composition.face_destination: Rect2(destination.x, destination.y + destination_caps.top, destination.width, destination.height - destination_caps.top - destination_caps.bottom)
cast_composition.face_mapping: One continuous clean material sample over the full destination face rectangle, clipped to the six-point inner contour, including both pointed ends.
cast_composition.rim_mapping: Draw the original gold/cyan ring between corresponding outer and inner edges after the face, using the existing nine-slice mapping.

clean_center_ring_samples.purpose: Exclude the baked original cost crystal and its shadow while retaining clean painted cyan/gold material at matching source heights.

cast_composition.live_content: CAST label, live cost crystal and value, availability, state feedback and input remain separate from the sampled artwork.

stats_borrowed_forecast_frame.status: Superseded by the original approved stats rails in the full-screen polish pass.

stats_composition.cause: The rectangular replacement face crossed the diagonal inner edge of the gold frame; increasing outer containment did not protect that inner bevel. Separately, arena environment/actor/status layers at z20/21/22 overpainted the z0 stats row top edge; the 720px live capture exposed three affected rows.
stats_composition.frame: Closed approved forecast frame, with all live content excluded from its sampled border regions.
stats_composition.divider_destination: 8*art_scale wide; confined to the unchanged content well y=11..41 in the 54px row
stats_composition.previous_incomplete_correction: The closed frame corrected the shared open rails, but rectangular center replacement with 27/11/27/11 source caps still covered diagonal inner bevel pixels. Earlier checks covered outer bounds and child padding, not painted inner-bevel containment.
stats_composition.method: Draw the clean stats face clipped to the eight-point inner contour, then draw the original stats rim ring between the outer and inner contours above it.

layer_contract.purpose: Keep the complete stats rim above arena art bleed and below inspection UI. Arena allocation, crop, row size, padding and layout geometry are unchanged.

mobile_polish_v2.stats: Clip away the source crypt stones outside the gold tabs and lower rim; retain the existing 54px layout and 30px content well.
mobile_polish_v2.pass_adjacent_line: The nominal toolbar left cap sampled x21..46 and included the original WIRING paper beginning around x42. The left-middle slice now samples only x21..41.
mobile_polish_v2.heading: Fill the complete header bounds with a clean text-free source patch before drawing the lower gold rule.
mobile_polish_v2.status: Historical implementation record; current stats geometry is described by stats_composition.

stats_composition.frame: Original approved Health/Energy/Turn rails, angled flared corners and divider shoulders.
stats_composition.destination_caps_formula: source_caps * destination_height / 69; fit to destination extent
stats_composition.method: Draw the clean face clipped strictly inside the ten-point recess, then draw the source rim ring above it. Sample clean top/bottom middle rail spans to avoid baked dividers. Draw original flared divider silhouettes separately at live thirds.
stats_composition.divider_destination: For each live third x: k=height/69, Rect2(x-16*k, 0, 35*k, height); silhouette points map uniformly from source.

layer_contract.purpose: Keep the complete stats rim above arena art bleed and below inspection UI.

stats_endcap_repair.cause: The original status strip has open sides between its corner flares; source-exact sampling preserved the missing gold links.
stats_endcap_repair.donor: Original status divider, clipped to its gold silhouette and source y520..573.
stats_endcap_repair.right_destination: Rect2(row width - 36*k, 0, 35*k, row height), horizontally mirrored
stats_endcap_repair.layering: Draw the bridges after the existing clipped face and rim. Original horizontal rails, 54px row and 36px content well remain unchanged.

2026-10-16-rejected-patched-stats.status: Superseded: owner rejected patched side borders and requested a proper directly drawn border.

2026-10-16-rejected-drawn-stats.method: One directly drawn closed gold bezel with chamfered corners and two straight dividers. No atlas rim or endcap patches.
2026-10-16-rejected-drawn-stats.source_pixels: Only the clean slate face samples the atlas. Legacy stats reference-region/cap metadata is not used to render the border.

socket_composition.selection: scripts/ui/main.gd assigns socket_variant = board cell index; CombatSurface selects posmod(socket_variant, 7).
socket_composition.method: Shared nine-slice socket rim with one of seven unoccupied approved-cell interior patches in the center; all board content and wiring remain live.

ribbon_composition.destination_caps_formula: Vector4(86,9,88,10) * art_scale, fitted to destination extent
ribbon_composition.method: Retain original torn emerald endcaps at their measured proportions and mask neighboring crypt pixels. Live completion text/check and state tint remain separate.

reference_icons.mask_contract: Source-space contour masks preserve original RGB and immediate dark outlines; up to four disconnected contours with a 0.55-source-pixel signed-distance feather remove the slate between Menu bars and Sound waves.
reference_icons.board_glyphs: board_texture(spark/shield) retains the generated atlas and virtual canvas margins; visible fractions 0.75/0.68 respectively.
reference_icons.fallback: Other glyphs retain shared SVGs. Sound-off uses its SVG with the approved contour material cleared.

combat_typography.roles: Combat labels remain live text. The product wordmark alone is approved static artwork.

local_overrides.stats: Value variation, top/bottom spacing -4/-5; HP/Energy 28px, Turn 22px.
local_overrides.cast: Display variation at weight 850, width 100, outline 4; normal label 43px and live value 44px, both 28px below 500 logical viewport width.
local_overrides.navigation: Label variation at 19px, top/bottom spacing -5/-5; below 400 logical width use 17px, with Sound at 16px. Icon lane y=13..49; caption lane y=52..70 with explicit side/outer-rail insets.
local_overrides.card_title: Label variation at 18px, reduced to 16px as needed to fit.
local_overrides.card_description: Body variation at 16px, top/bottom spacing -3/-3, line spacing 0; live long text retains its scroll lane.
local_overrides.tool_title_and_count: Label 15px with spacing -2/-2; value 18px with spacing -4/-4.
local_overrides.endpoint_captions: Display small-cap variation at weight 700 and width 62.5; 14px for cells at most 80px wide, otherwise min(26, round(cell_width*0.19)); two-pixel outline and glyph gap.

combat_typography.limit: Noto Serif is a live approximation; the flattened reference does not identify or provide its original font.

begin.method: ApprovedBeginGlyph TextureRect binds the original atlas sample and contour material in the existing get_endpoint_geometry().glyph_rect, keeps aspect centered and stays upright. The live caption and logical wires render separately; only wires rotate.
begin.input: The decorative glyph ignores mouse input and takes no focus; the existing cell owns interaction.

end.reason: The approved reference gold wire covers the top center of the End cyan rim around source x495..505,y1093..1110, and baked END text overlaps the lower opening. Retain the existing SVG rather than invent missing original pixels.
end.caption: Live small-cap text, separate from the glyph and rotating logical wires.
